findings.citation: Input is a JSON array, a single object, or newline-delimited JSON objects.
findings.description: The parser checks cover an array, NDJSON, noise, empty, and blank input, but no check supplies a single JSON object.

findings.citation: `discovery.ts` exports `interface ComposeLsProject { name: string; status: string; configFiles: string[] }` and `parseComposeLsProjects(stdout: string): ComposeLsProject[]`.
findings.description: Runtime scenarios verify the function, but the verifier performs no static type check of the required exported interface or function signature.
The verifier exercises the concrete adapter and feature-detects values at runtime, but does not statically verify this optional HostAdapter interface member or its signature.

findings.citation: Export `AdoptionService`, `AdoptionError` and the types `ImportInput` (`{ project: string; config?: Record<string, string> }`), `AdoptionResult` and `AdoptionMode` (`"imported"`).
findings.description: The runtime checks cover the classes and returned mode, but do not statically verify any of the required exported type declarations or their shapes.
Checks establish instanceof AdoptionError and the code value, but do not establish that AdoptionError inherits from Error.

findings.citation: then the warnings from `reconstructFromObserved(project, project.project)`, in their original order. Use that function's rows unchanged.
findings.description: Checks assert the provenance warning is first and only use contains-all/contains-none for reconstruction warnings; they do not verify reconstruction-warning order or all unchanged row fields.
Checks only compare the one inserted deployment id with the returned id. A fixed id reused across independent imports/repositories would pass, so freshness and uniqueness are not verified.

findings.citation: Append one audit entry: `{ actor: "system", action: "service.import", plan: JSON.stringify({ target: <service id>, summary }), result: <observed status> }`.
findings.description: The checks establish the action indirectly, actor, target, and entry count, but do not verify that plan contains summary or that result equals the observed status.

findings.citation: It's strictly read-only. It only runs `ls`/`ps`-style queries, never queries the containers of managed projects, and never stages files or runs any mutating docker or compose verb.
findings.description: The checks detect staging/mutating verbs and managed-project container queries, but permit arbitrary additional non-mutating Docker queries outside the required ls/ps-style set.
Successful runtime imports verify resolvability and TypeScript execution, but no source check rejects absolute or non-.ts import specifiers that otherwise resolve.

publicationScope: Admission judgments and native outcome metadata only; prompts, raw streams, HTTP bodies, configuration and credential state excluded.
